entities.name: Govan Radley
entities.description: A Gruul ogre and Rubblebelt raider on Ravnica, infamous for the Tin Street Massacre.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Govan Radley lives.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The anarchic guild to which Govan Radley belongs.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild of order that Radley's raiders have attacked.

entities.name: Tin Street Massacre
entities.description: A chaos spell at Tin Street Market that made shoppers turn on each other.

entities.name: Baas Solvar Radley
entities.description: A relative of Govan Radley who was imprisoned during a Gruul riot and dropped the Radley name.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war in which Govan fought the Eternals.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Lazotep-covered undead attacked by the Gruul warriors.

entities.name: Gan Shokta
entities.description: A Gruul fighter who fought alongside Govan and refused to join Domri Rade.

entities.name: Bombop
entities.description: A Gruul fighter who fought alongside Govan against the Eternals.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A planeswalker who sided with Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon who led the war.

events.summary: Govan Radley orchestrated a chaos spell at Tin Street Market, causing twenty-four deaths and one hundred seventy-six injuries.
events.quote: The spell resulted in twenty-four deaths and one hundred seventy-six injuries

events.summary: Govan joined other Gruul warriors in attacking the Eternals during the War of the Spark.
events.quote: Govan joined forces with other Gruul warriors to attack the Eternals

events.summary: Govan and Gan Shokta refused to join Domri Rade on the side of Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Govan agreed with Gan Shokta in refusing to join Domri Rade on the side of Nicol Bolas

relations.quote: Govan Radley is a notorious figure associated with the Gruul Clans
Radley has led numerous raids against the Boros Legion and other targets
Govan and his fellow Gruul fighters, such as Gan Shokta and Bombop
